source: The Candlestick Trading Bible - Sanyog Raut

trending.trading_approach: Enter at end of retracement (pullback to key level), not during the retracement
trending.entry_rule: Wait for signal at S/R, trendline, or 21MA after pullback
trending.avoid: Buying/selling during the retracement - gets stopped out by professionals

ranging.definition: Price horizontal between definable S/R with >=2 touches each
strategies: Buy at support / sell at resistance boundaries
Wait for breakout, then enter or wait for pullback after breakout
ranging.avoid: Choppy markets with no identifiable S/R

bullish_pin_bar_hammer.anatomy: open/high/close roughly equal, small body, long lower tail >=2x body
bullish_pin_bar_hammer.psychology: Sellers pushed down but buyers rejected strongly - bullish rejection
bullish_pin_bar_hammer.entry_aggressive: At close of the pin bar
bullish_pin_bar_hammer.entry_conservative: After 50% retracement of pin bar range
bullish_pin_bar_hammer.stop_loss: Below the long tail (beyond the wick)
bullish_pin_bar_hammer.profit_target: Next resistance level or support flip
bullish_pin_bar_hammer.confluence_requirement: 1-2 factors: trend direction + S/R or 21MA rejection

bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.anatomy: open/low/close roughly equal, small body, long upper tail >=2x body
bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.psychology: Buyers pushed up but sellers rejected strongly - bearish rejection
bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.entry_aggressive: At close of the pin bar
bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.entry_conservative: After 50% retracement of pin bar range
bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.stop_loss: Above the long tail (beyond the wick)
bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.profit_target: Next support level or resistance flip
bearish_pin_bar_shooting_star.confluence_requirement: 1-2 factors: trend direction + S/R or 21MA rejection

bullish_engulfing_bar.anatomy: 2 candles: small bearish candle fully engulfed by larger bullish candle
bullish_engulfing_bar.psychology: Sellers lost control, buyers overwhelmed - capitulation bottom
nison_criteria: First body entirely engulfed by second
Second body opposite color of first
bullish_engulfing_bar.entry: Immediately after the engulfing bar closes
bullish_engulfing_bar.profit_target: Next key level (S/R, MA, or Fibonacci)

bearish_engulfing_bar.anatomy: 2 candles: small bullish candle fully engulfed by larger bearish candle
bearish_engulfing_bar.psychology: Buyers lost control, sellers overwhelmed - top reversal
bearish_engulfing_bar.entry: Immediately after the engulfing bar closes

bullish_inside_bar.anatomy: Mother candle + baby candle fully inside mother's range, bullish breakout
bullish_inside_bar.entry: After breakout of the inside bar pattern (not on horizontal level breakout)

bearish_inside_bar.anatomy: Mother candle + baby candle inside mother's range, bearish breakout
bearish_inside_bar.entry: After breakout of the inside bar pattern

inside_bar_false_breakout.anatomy: Price breaks out of inside bar then reverses and closes back inside mother range
inside_bar_false_breakout.psychology: Big players hunting stops / grabbing liquidity
inside_bar_false_breakout.entry: After close of the break bar (the bar that broke out then closed back inside)

morning_star.anatomy: 3 candles: bearish body + small indecision candle + bullish body closing above midpoint of first
morning_star.context: At bottom of downtrend near support = powerful bullish reversal

evening_star.anatomy: 3 candles: bullish body + small indecision candle + large bearish body gapping lower
evening_star.context: At top of uptrend = bearish reversal

doji.anatomy: Open equals close (within 5% of range). Indecision/equality.

variants.dragonfly_doji: Bullish doji with long lower tail near support
variants.gravestone_doji: Bearish doji with long upper tail near resistance

doji.use: Signal that prior trend is losing strength. Take profits or combine with other analysis. Not an entry signal alone.

confluence_factors.name: Trend direction
confluence_factors.rule: Trade with the trend; signal against trend requires higher-TF level confirmation

confluence_factors.name: Support/Resistance levels
confluence_factors.rule: Broken level flips role: resistance becomes support, support becomes resistance

confluence_factors.name: Moving averages (8/21 SMA)
confluence_factors.rule: 21MA = dynamic support in uptrend, dynamic resistance in downtrend. 200 SMA = trend filter.

confluence_factors.name: Fibonacci retracement (50%/61.8%)
confluence_factors.rule: Major moves retrace to 50%/61%. Signal at these levels = high probability

confluence_factors.name: Trend lines
confluence_factors.rule: Connect >=2 swing points on 4H/daily. Catches trades horizontal S/R misses.

confluence_factors.name: Bollinger Bands
confluence_factors.rule: Range markets only: rejection from band + horizontal level = confirmation

confluence_factors.name: Supply/Demand zones
confluence_factors.rule: Institutional order zones. Quality: fast move away + good R:R + bigger timeframe

entry_exit_summary.entry: At 50% retrace of pin bar range
After breakout of inside bar range
At close of break bar after reversal
On pullback to flipped level with signal

money_management.position_sizing_rule: Think in dollars risked, not pips
money_management.stop_loss_type: Always hard stop loss order placed with entry. Never mental stops.
money_management.expectation_math: At 3:1 R:R, 30% win rate is profitable (7 losses x 1R + 3 wins x 3R = +2R)
cardinal_rules: Never risk money you cannot afford to lose
Set stop and target at entry, then leave the trade
Accept losing trades as part of the system
